title: Orchestration Phase Output
description: JSON Schema contract for the Orchestrator agent output. The Orchestrator drives milestone-by-milestone execution with inter-milestone verification, stopping on failure and allowing resume from any milestone.

orchestration_id.description: The identifier passed as argument (e.g., s1us005)

from_milestone.description: First milestone executed in this orchestration run

to_milestone.description: Last milestone attempted in this orchestration run

skip_verify.description: Whether verification was skipped between milestones

milestones_status.description: Status of every milestone in the plan

name.description: Milestone name from the planning file

tasks.description: Task IDs belonging to this milestone

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when milestone execution started

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when milestone execution finished

current_milestone.description: The milestone number where execution currently stands (last attempted or in-progress)

overall_status.description: Overall orchestration status. 'success' only if all milestones pass verification.

next_action.description: Suggested next action for the user (e.g., '/milestone-impl s1us005 --milestone 3 --tasks T006' or '/orchestrate s1us005 --from 4')
